title: Write-Behind Cache Pattern — Companion Code
description: Runnable write-behind cache implementations with a durable Redis dirty set, atomic flush takeover and batch upserts, in Python and TypeScript, that accompany the Write-Behind Cache Pattern resource.
description_es: Implementaciones ejecutables de caché write-behind con dirty set durable en Redis, toma atómica del volcado y upserts en lote, en Python y TypeScript, que acompañan al recurso del Patrón Write-Behind Cache.
